text: {"components": [{"type": "obligation", "quote": "doivent prendre position dans un délai de deux mois", "gist": "Offices must provide their position within two months"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "l’OFEN forme dans les deux mois un groupe d’accompagnement spécifique au projet", "gist": "OFEN must form a project-specific support group within two months"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "Après réception de leurs prises de position", "gist": "After receiving their positions"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Conférence de la Confédération pour l’organisation du territoire (COT)", "gist": "Conference of the Confederation for Spatial Planning (COT)"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Office fédéral de l’énergie (OFEN)", "gist": "Federal Office of Energy (OFEN)"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "groupe d’accompagnement", "gist": "support group"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il peut organiser une visite des zones de planification potentielles avec ce groupe", "gist": "It may organize a visit to potential planning zones with this group"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Celle-ci doit être suffisamment grande pour permettre l’élaboration de plusieurs corridors de planification", "gist": "The recommended planning zone must be large enough to allow development of multiple planning corridors"}]}
